source_snapshot.procedure: Power on, enter an Advanced BMC license if needed, record Maximum Available/Peak Observed/Minimum Observed power, enable capping, set the cap to Maximum Available Power, apply it, and stress the server for 30 hours.
source_snapshot.criteria: CPU power utilization is capped; Average Power remains below the Power Cap line, while Maximum Power may cross it.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek reduces a license, cap-write and long stress validation to read-only sensor/Redfish collection, uses a guessed Chassis URI and cannot test enforcement or restoration.

original_test_intent.purpose: SOURCE_CONFLICT: determine whether this row is a read-only CPU cap/limit query or a state-changing system power-cap enforcement test, then resolve the test domain, authoritative duration and stimulus before defining execution.
original_test_intent.target: Unresolved: the title and criterion name CPU capping, while the BMC Power Settings fields and generic Redfish PowerControl commonly describe chassis/system power. The exact processor/package/system/chassis control domain and SUT must be identified.
original_test_intent.scope: The written procedure includes secure license entitlement, recording three BMC power metrics, enabling and writing a persistent cap, applying server stress, observing meter traces and restoring the initial state. Read-only limit inventory is only preparatory and cannot satisfy that workflow.
original_test_intent.operation: While blocked, discover read-only target/schema/control-domain and preserve original cap/license/power values without installing a key or changing settings. The owner must choose query-only versus enforcement validation, reconcile 30 hours with 1440 minutes, define a cap that can validly demonstrate enforcement, workload and evidence, then authorize a separately reviewed cap/write/stress/restore flow.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: Conflict: Procedure specifies 30 hours, while Machine Time is 1440 minutes (24 hours). No duration may be selected or shortened until the testcase owner corrects the source.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Unresolved. For an enforcement interpretation, merely observing average power below a cap set to Maximum Available Power does not prove the cap constrained the workload; an owner-defined demand-above-cap condition, domain-specific throttle/enforcement evidence, permitted transient rule and recovery are required.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Owner correction; target/control domain; discovered schema/resource and units; license entitlement without secret disclosure; original and applied cap/state; authoritative duration/workload; time-series demand/average/peak/cap plus CPU/package/chassis enforcement indicators; errors/thermal health; aborts; restored original cap/license/configuration and service health.
ambiguities: `Get` in the title conflicts with enabling and writing a cap plus long-duration stress in the procedure.
CPU capping conflicts with generic BMC system/chassis Power Settings semantics unless a platform mapping proves the controlled domain.
Thirty hours conflicts with the 1440-minute Machine Time.
A cap equal to Maximum Available Power plus average-below-cap acceptance may never create or prove an enforcement condition.
Stress tool, target resources, load level, sampling, tolerance, transient window and allowed Maximum-over-cap behavior are undefined.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly blocks the current cap write and 30-hour stress, rejects the read-only substitution and demands schema, license, safe limits, workload, watchdog and restore controls. It frames most gaps as missing inputs but does not explicitly record the 30-hour/24-hour source conflict, CPU-versus-chassis domain conflict or the non-proving cap-at-maximum acceptance design as independent semantic blockers.

applicable_history.decision: The historical YES verdict treats an OOB/DUT read-only command as execution even though it omits license, cap enable/write/apply, full stress duration, enforcement evidence and restoration.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep BLOCKED for genuine semantic conflicts, not merely missing artifacts. Query-only versus enforcement, CPU versus chassis domain, 30 versus 24 hours, and a non-demonstrative cap/acceptance design must be corrected by the owner. Only read-only discovery and baseline collection are allowed now.

available_now: BMC/SUT identity, advertised Redfish schemas/resources, current read-only license status, cap state and power metrics can be collected without setting a cap or starting stress.
The original cap/configuration can be documented for a future restoration plan without changing it.

DMTF's legacy Power.PowerControl.PowerLimit describes a chassis power limit in watts, while processor power-limit throttling is a separate processor metric; deployed platform mapping must establish the source's CPU claim.
missing_inputs: Owner-corrected purpose, control domain and source text; authoritative duration resolving 30 hours versus 1440 minutes
Advertised BMC schema/resource/member, units, writable-property semantics, persistent/volatile behavior, enable/apply sequence, allowed range and original-state restore method
Cap selection and workload that create a safe measurable enforcement condition, with sampling/aggregation, transient/peak tolerance and CPU/package/chassis throttle evidence
Protected advanced-license entitlement workflow, exact stress package/targets, dedicated window, workloads/users evacuation, independent thermal/power monitoring, abort and OOB recovery
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The testcase/platform power owner resolves intent, duration and domain; the BMC vendor supplies schema and license/cap semantics; CPU/performance/thermal owners define workload and enforcement evidence; security/operations approve entitlement, long stress, service impact and recovery.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Discover service root, Chassis/System/Processor links and advertised Power, PowerSubsystem, Control, EnvironmentMetrics or OEM resources; capture schema versions and current values with certificate-verified GET only.

Record current cap-enabled state, cap value, Maximum Available/Peak/Minimum/Average values, CPU/platform inventory, thermal/error baseline and existing license status, with secrets redacted and no log clearing.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not install/expose a license key, enable/write/apply a cap, start stress, choose 24 or 30 hours, assume `/Chassis/1/Power`, clear logs or infer CPU enforcement from chassis average power.
Do not choose a lower cap merely to force throttling, accept uncontrolled peak crossings, run on an active SUT, retry after anomaly or restore by guessing an original value.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: The corrected source names one purpose/domain/duration; schema discovery proves the exact writable control and units; the cap/workload produces an approved measurable enforcement condition within safe limits; sampling and peak rules are signed; secrets, baseline, monitoring, abort, maintenance and restoration have dry-run evidence.

revision_candidate.test_name: CPU or System Power-Cap Enforcement — Source Correction Required
revision_candidate.purpose: BLOCKED: resolve whether the requested activity is read-only limit retrieval or a power-cap enforcement stress test, and identify whether the controlled domain is CPU/package or whole-system/chassis power.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Unresolved until the owner identifies the SUT, BMC/firmware/license, advertised power-control schema, CPU/platform power domain, approved stress stack and the corrected duration.
revision_candidate.target_scope: No mutable target is authorized. Read-only discovery may cover candidate BMC chassis/system/processor power resources and the current cap state solely to resolve the source conflict.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Corrected purpose/domain; 30-hour-versus-1440-minute resolution; discovered schema/resource/units; license entitlement; original and safe cap/restore semantics; enforcement-producing workload; sampling/transient/tolerance rules; throttle proof; packages; maintenance/approval; monitoring/abort/recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Do not produce an executable write/stress command. First collect read-only schema, current cap/license and power baselines. After owner correction, separately review the exact secure license, cap enable/set/read-back, full-duration workload, synchronized CPU/system power and throttling evidence, stop rules and original-state restoration procedure.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Source conflict resolved; exact SUT/domain/resource identified; authoritative duration and acceptance fixed; secrets protected; workload and cap validated to demonstrate enforcement safely; idle dedicated SUT; baseline/config backup; continuous independent monitoring; tested abort/OOB/restore and explicit approval.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Owner correction; schema and control-domain proof; protected entitlement record; original/capped settings and read-back; exact workload/duration; synchronized cap/demand/average/peak plus CPU/package/chassis throttle data; thermal/error/host/BMC logs; aborts; original-state restoration and final workload/system health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The corrected testcase plus exact BMC/platform power-control and CPU enforcement specification. Generic Redfish power fields alone do not prove CPU-specific capping or define safe acceptance.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Read-only discovery only while blocked. Never disclose/install a key, write a cap, start stress, guess duration/domain/resource/limit, clear logs, bypass TLS, use production workloads or infer enforcement from average-below-cap alone.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Owner correction is mandatory. Security approves license handling; operations, CPU/performance and power/thermal owners approve the cap, workload, full duration, thresholds, service impact and recovery immediately before execution.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Owners must correct semantics, provide entitlement and approve the high-load campaign. After a new review, supported cap control, workload, monitoring and evidence may be automated; secret entry, emergency intervention and failed restoration remain controlled human actions.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No mutation is authorized while blocked. A corrected flow must capture the original state, abort workload on any limit/error, restore cap enable/value through the validated path, preserve evidence, verify CPU/system performance and thermal/BMC/OS health, and escalate failed restoration without automatic retry.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Any unresolved purpose/domain/duration/criterion; unknown resource or cap semantics; absent license security, package, maintenance, monitoring, abort, OOB or restoration; active workload; cap/workload unable to demonstrate enforcement safely; telemetry loss, thermal/power/error fault or secret exposure.

identified_defects: The source title and automation imply read-only retrieval while the procedure requires persistent cap configuration and long stress.
Procedure duration conflicts with Machine Time by six hours.
CPU-specific acceptance is not mapped to the BMC's likely chassis/system power-control domain.
Setting the cap to Maximum Available Power and checking only average-below-cap may not exercise enforcement.
reason_for_change: Convert a generic missing-input BLOCKED explanation into a precise source-conflict decision: four unresolved choices materially change the command, target, duration and proof of power-cap enforcement, while still allowing safe read-only discovery.

new_technical_evidence.title: DMTF Redfish Property Guide, DSP2053 2025.2
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Redfish implementations advertising the cited Power and ProcessorMetrics properties
new_technical_evidence.supports: PowerControl.PowerLimit is defined for chassis power, while PowerLimitThrottleDuration is a distinct processor metric; control and enforcement domains must not be conflated.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The deployed BMC may implement legacy, newer Control/EnvironmentMetrics or OEM resources and may not expose a processor throttle metric.

new_technical_evidence.title: DMTF Redfish Resource and Schema Guide, DSP2046 2025.2
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Current Redfish schema guidance; deployed service version controls actual paths
new_technical_evidence.supports: The legacy Power schema is deprecated in favor of newer power-subsystem modeling, so `/Chassis/1/Power` must be discovered and version-validated rather than assumed.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The platform may intentionally retain the legacy resource and vendor-specific capping semantics.

removed_ambiguities: Explicitly separates read-only query from state-changing enforcement validation.
Surfaces the 30-hour versus 24-hour conflict rather than silently choosing one.
Separates CPU throttle evidence from chassis power-limit metrics and rejects average-below-cap as sole proof.
resolved_blockers: Read-only schema, license-status, cap-state and power baseline collection can proceed without choosing the final interpretation or changing the SUT.
remaining_blockers: All write/stress execution remains blocked until the owner resolves purpose, domain, duration and enforcement design and supplies secure license, workload, monitoring, approval and restoration controls.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 preserves V2's hard safety stop but identifies the irreducible source conflicts that justify BLOCKED, prevents a 24/30-hour silent change and a chassis-to-CPU evidence error, and states exactly which read-only work remains safe.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The genuine source-conflict rationale and CPU-versus-chassis boundary are queued for the next isolated validation batch.

regression_status.notes: No duration was selected because 30 hours conflicts with 1440 minutes.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The row records BMC Maximum Available/Peak/Minimum power, enables a cap at Maximum Available Power, applies stress for 30 hours and expects average below cap, while Machine Time is 1440 minutes.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 safely blocks execution but does not explicitly distinguish the duration, domain, query-versus-write and non-proving enforcement conflicts from missing provisionable inputs.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Permit certificate-verified read-only discovery and baseline only; forbid license entry, cap writes and stress until a corrected source and complete monitored restore contract exist.
